name: Disable Windows Consumer Experience
description: Prevents Windows from automatically downloading and installing promotional apps (Candy Crush, Disney+, Spotify stubs, etc.).
reason: Reduces unwanted background app downloads and telemetry.
estimated_benefit: Saves 200-800 MB disk space and background bandwidth.

name: Disable Bing Web Search in Start Menu
description: Restricts Start Menu search to local files, apps, and settings, removing web search latency and telemetry.
reason: Significantly speeds up Start Menu searches and stops search queries from being sent to Bing.
estimated_benefit: Faster local search, zero web query latency in Start Menu.

name: Disable Advertising ID Tracking
description: Disables unique advertising identifier used by apps to track user behavior across applications.
reason: Protects user privacy by denying ad tracking identifiers.
estimated_benefit: Improved privacy, zero personalized ad profile generation.

name: Remove Preinstalled Promotional UWP Apps
description: Removes non-essential preinstalled app packages (Feedback Hub, Solitaire, Tips, Get Help, News).
reason: Eliminates preinstalled bloat apps that consume background CPU and storage.
estimated_benefit: Recovers ~300-600 MB disk space and reduces background task churn.

name: Set Diagnostic Data to Basic Level
description: Sets Windows diagnostic telemetry to the minimum required level without breaking Windows Update.
reason: Minimizes unnecessary operating system usage metric collection.
estimated_benefit: Reduces disk I/O and background network data transmission.

name: Disable Start Menu App Suggestions
description: Prevents Windows from displaying recommended and suggested promotional apps in Start Menu.
reason: Keeps the Start Menu clean and free of third-party promotional recommendations.
estimated_benefit: Cleaner Start Menu with zero recommended ads.

name: Disable Windows 11 Widgets Feed
description: Disables the Windows 11 Widgets news feed (Windows Web Experience Pack) background tasks.
reason: Widgets feed spawns multiple WebView2 processes consuming 150-300 MB of idle RAM.
estimated_benefit: Saves 150-300 MB RAM and prevents continuous MSN news syncing.

name: Disable Windows Copilot Integration
description: Disables the Windows Copilot side panel and Taskbar icon.
reason: Prevents Copilot web rendering background services if unused.
estimated_benefit: Saves background memory and cleans up Taskbar.

name: Disable Xbox Live & Game Bar Services (Non-Gamers)
description: Sets Xbox Live auth, save, and network services to Manual startup. Does not delete Xbox components.
reason: Stops idle Xbox background services on workstations not used for Xbox gaming.
estimated_benefit: Reduces 4 background services and saves 20-50 MB idle RAM.

name: Disable Cortana Background Launcher
description: Disables Cortana voice assistant background initialization and startup hook.
reason: Cortana is superseded in modern Windows versions; disabling background hooks frees resources.
estimated_benefit: Saves 30-60 MB memory and removes background voice trigger listener.

name: Disable Microsoft Edge Startup Boost & Pre-launch
description: Prevents Microsoft Edge from running standby background processes at Windows login.
reason: Stops Edge from consuming 100-250 MB RAM on boot when user uses other browsers.
estimated_benefit: Recovers 100-250 MB RAM at startup and reduces boot time.

name: Remove OEM Support Stubs & Preinstalled Promos
description: Removes 3rd-party preinstalled vendor stubs (Spotify, Disney+, TikTok, Instagram, Prime Video stubs).
reason: Eliminates factory preinstalled OEM promotional app stubs.
estimated_benefit: Recovers storage space and removes unwanted start menu entries.

name: Disable Windows Location Tracking Service
description: Disables background geolocation sensor service (lfsvc) and location history.
reason: Desktop workstations rarely need continuous GPS location querying.
estimated_benefit: Saves background service overhead and prevents location tracking.

name: Disable Activity History & Timeline Cloud Sync
description: Stops Windows from recording launched apps, opened documents, and browsing history to cloud Timeline.
reason: Eliminates continuous user activity indexing and cloud synchronization.
estimated_benefit: Reduces disk writes and prevents activity tracking.

name: Disable Windows Feedback Frequency Prompts
description: Sets Windows feedback survey prompt frequency to 'Never'.
reason: Prevents Windows from interrupting the user with feedback survey dialogs.
